name: Solace in the Roses
source:
While exploring the botanical gardens you decided to wander into a section that never interested you before: the rose garden. At the heart of the rose garden you met a strange man dressed as a prince. He insisted that he knew you although you had no memories of him. How were you to know that speaking to him would change your life forever?

[From [url=https://flowering-flame-studios.itch.io/solace-in-the-roses=]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在探索植物园时，你决定走进一个你以前从未感兴趣的区域：玫瑰园。在玫瑰园的中心，你遇到了一个装扮成王子的奇怪男人。他坚称他认识你，尽管你对他没有任何记忆。你怎么知道与他交谈会永远改变你的生活？

[来自[url=https://flowering-flame-studios.itch.io/solace-in-the-roses=]itch.io[/url]]
